text: Please create a private GitHub repo for Dilli Darshan and tell me its URL. I keep working and push once it exists.

Test build for Windows: harness/reports/builds/Kalesh-windows.zip (exe plus the map pack, unsigned). It cannot be run on this Mac. Please try it on your PC and on your friend's: unzip, double click Kalesh.exe, and tell me whether it starts, shows the city and drives (Windows may warn that the app is unsigned: More info, Run anyway).

Optional: if you are ever at the ITO crossing or on GB Road, a few phone photos of the junction layout and the street (no people needed) would close the two gaps no free photo covers. Drop them in assets_inbox/. Nothing waits on this.

Photo requests (only if you are nearby; nothing waits): 1) Chandni Chowk main road, daylight, standing in the middle of the street, 2022 or later. 2) G.B. Road at street level, and the Ajmeri Gate itself. 3) The ITO crossing from driver height, and the Pragati Maidan tunnel mouth. Drop them in Messages on the dashboard.
One photo still missing (only if nearby; nothing waits): the Ajmeri Gate itself, from the street.
